active_blocks: No permission for bulk copying of protected corpora; only bounded non-verbatim paraphrases and locators are stored.
Incoming correspondence is absent from many Igrot Kodesh response cases, so context remains Partial where the incoming question is unavailable.
Underlying manuscript, photograph or secretariat-copy witnesses named by publisher notes were not independently inspected; Verified is scoped to the authorized item-level publisher witness.

Retrieval now has proposition-level relevance gates, topic aliases, claim-local citation entailment checks and a separate researcher evidence map, but ranking remains deterministic and lexical/topic-based rather than a semantic entailment model.
Translated public talks are one manifestation of their dated event; original-language transcripts and recordings must join the same Evidence Family.
next_work: Continue Hebrew/Yiddish item-level inspection where public body text is accessible; keep audio-only metadata and publisher shells out of answer evidence.
Inspect remaining pending AIDs 4666211, 4666265, 4666267, 4666268 and 4666270 only if a public body becomes available; do not infer from title or ID.
Expand event-level Evidence Family links when original-language transcripts, audio or video of already indexed talks become available.
Adversarially test proposition relevance, claim-local citation entailment, context boundaries and researcher-mode witness distinctions on both answer modes.
Continue reconciling the live public-search index, metrics and content-readiness test after each content batch.

primary_user_question: עד כמה אפשר לסמוך על זה?
ux.default_experience: answer-first; technical provenance progressively disclosed; original source opens directly where lawful
ux.answer_model: proposition-grounded multi-source synthesis with high relevance threshold and numbered claim-level citations
ux.regular_mode: concise answer-first synthesis plus numbered evidence list
ux.researcher_mode: extended evidence analysis with subclaims, witness provenance, verification scope, context completeness, source-type/period/audience distinctions, Evidence Families, tensions and unanswered aspects
ux.language_policy: cross-language retrieval across Hebrew, Yiddish, English and any additional direct/authorized source languages; translations are derived, not independent witnesses
ux.precision_policy: precision over recall; lexical-only matches rejected; insufficient evidence is an acceptable result

verification_surge.effort_target: 75-85% promotion/verification until backlog is materially reduced; 15-25% breadth expansion
verification_surge.homogeneous_batch_target: 20-50 records when direct authorized item witnesses are stable and rights permit
blocking_reasons: metadata ambiguity or unresolved identity/dedup conflict
